### Chapter 1 · The Home Nurse And Raphael Amma
*The Home Nurse And Raphael Amma*

1. Jack was a home nurse. One morning his manager sent him to a new patient. An extraordinary old woman, he called her.
   ↳ *story in the street (day): jack idle; manager talk → point · props: car*
2. Jack asked if it was really okay. Of course it's okay, said the manager. You will get paid a lot. Go in.
   ↳ *story in the street (day): jack think → says, idle; manager talk → says, point*
3. The granny welcomed him with a cup of chai. Sit on the sofa and wait, she said. I have to go to my room.
   ↳ *story in the home (day): granny offer → says, walk; jack sit → … · props: door*
4. Hours passed. On the shelf, Jack found a photo. The granny, standing next to another home nurse.
   ↳ *story in the home (sunset): jack idle → hold · props: photo, door*
5. That one left early, she said. Jack was not so sure about that.
   ↳ *story in the home (sunset): jack hold → think; granny talk → says, idle · props: door*
6. She showed him the guest room. There was one rule. Do not be awake after midnight. Or else.
   ↳ *story in the bedroom (sunset): granny point → says, says; jack idle → …*
7. The first nights, Jack could not sleep. Just homesick, he told himself. Just homesick.
   ↳ *story in the bedroom (night): jack lie · props: candle*
8. But every day, the granny got meaner. She snapped at him. She pinched him. She hit him.
   ↳ *story in the home (day): granny angry → point, swing; jack idle → scared · props: door*
9. One night he was still awake after midnight. And then he heard it. Knocking. Slow. Odd. Knocking.
   ↳ *story in the bedroom (night): jack sit → scared · props: candle, text “KNOCK. KNOCK.”*
10. He fell asleep right there. In the morning he told himself it was just a bad dream. Just a nightmare.
   ↳ *story in the bedroom (day): jack lie → sit*
11. The next night, she came into his room. And she told him a story. Not about herself, she said. About Raphael Amma.
   ↳ *story in the bedroom (night): jack sit; granny idle → walk, says · props: door*
12. Raphael Amma had a husband, Raphael Appa, and seven children. And every single one of them ignored her.
   ↳ *story in the home (night): granny sad; appa sit; kid1 idle; kid2 idle; kid3 idle; kid4 idle; kid5 idle; kid6 idle; kid7 idle*
13. She did not divorce him. She prayed. To the devil. I want to eat them all, she said. But the three youngest later. When they are older.
   ↳ *story in the cabin (night): granny pray → says · props: candle, candle, book*
14. And she ate them. One by one. The devil moved in. Until only the three youngest were left.
   ↳ *story in the home (night): granny possessed; appa sit → run; kid1 scared → run; kid2 scared → run; kid3 scared → run; kid4 scared → run; kid5 idle; kid6 idle; kid7 idle*
15. Years later, she ate two more. But the last child she loved. She let him run away from the house. The devil, she said, would find him anyway.
   ↳ *story in the woods (night): granny possessed → sad; kid5 scared → run; kid6 scared → run; kid7 idle → run*
16. Jack was terrified. That same night, when the granny went out, he ran.
   ↳ *story in the bedroom (night): jack scared → run, run · props: door, candle*
17. He ran through the dark, deep into the woods. And he ended up in front of a small hut.
   ↳ *story in the woods (night): jack run → run, …*
18. Inside: blood on the floor. And a book, full of odd letters. The first words read: Dear devil.
   ↳ *story in the cabin (night): jack idle → hold · props: stain, stain, stain, table, book, candle, axe, text “Dear devil,”*
19. Jack knew there was no way out of this house. He sat down on the floor. And he cried.
   ↳ *story in the cabin (night): jack cry · props: stain, table, book, candle*
20. Behind him, the door opened. Raphael Amma. Possessed. With an axe in her hand.
   ↳ *story in the cabin (night): jack cry; granny possessed → walk · props: door, stain, candle, table*
21. Because the devil had kept his promise. Jack was the missing son. The last child. The one she let run away.
   ↳ *story in the cabin (night): jack cry → sit; granny raise → swing · props: stain*
22. The axe fell. And the moment Jack was gone, the devil had nothing left to keep. Raphael Amma turned to dust.
